examples.vi: Chúng tôi đi qua hẻm núi có suối một cách lặng lẽ.

senses.description: A license authorizing two people to marry.

examples.en: They filed the wedding licence with the office.
examples.vi: Họ nộp giấy phép kết hôn tại văn phòng.

senses.description: To heave up an anchor in preparation for sailing.

examples.en: We need to weigh anchor before departure.
examples.vi: Chúng ta cần nhổ neo trước khi rời đi.

senses.description: A mask worn for protection when welding.

examples.en: The welder's mask protects the eyes from sparks.
examples.vi: Mặt nạ hàn bảo vệ mắt khỏi tia lửa.

senses.description: A fee charged for using a wharf or quay.

examples.en: The port charges wharfage fees.
examples.vi: Cảng phí sử dụng cầu tàu tính phí.

senses.description: A platform built out from the shore into the water and supported by piles, providing access to ships and boats.

examples.en: The wharfage extends along the river.
examples.vi: Cầu tàu kéo dài dọc theo sông.

senses.description: An eastern Australian tree widely cultivated for shade and for its glossy leaves and circular clusters of showy red to orange-scarlet flowers.

examples.en: The wheel tree shades the garden beautifully.
examples.vi: Cây bánh xe che bóng mát cho khu vườn rất đẹp.

senses.description: A beer made from wheat by top fermentation, usually very pale, cloudy, and effervescent.

examples.en: We enjoyed a cloudy white beer with lunch.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi thưởng thức bia lúa mì trắng đục cùng bữa trưa.

senses.description: Bread made with finely ground and usually bleached wheat flour.

examples.en: White bread is common in sandwiches.
examples.vi: Bánh mì trắng phổ biến trong các chiếc bánh sandwich.

senses.description: A common North American deer whose tail has a white underside.

examples.en: A deer with a white tail appeared.
examples.vi: Một con hươu có đuôi trắng xuất hiện.

senses.description: A perennial European bellflower with racemose white or blue flowers.

examples.en: We planted a willow bell in the garden.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi trồng hoa chuông liễu trong vườn.

senses.description: A white or grayish calcium silicate mineral typically found in metamorphic limestone.

examples.en: Wollastonite forms in metamorphic rocks.
examples.vi: Wollastonite hình thành trong đá biến chất.

senses.description: A woody vine of eastern North America with large oval leaves, small white flowers, and purple to blue-black fruits.

examples.en: A yellow parilla vines across the fence.
examples.vi: Dây parilla vàng bò ngang qua hàng rào.

senses.description: A camel cavalry used in the early modern era by Arab, Afghan, Persian, and Indian armies.

examples.en: The zamburek rode at dawn.
examples.vi: Lúc bình minh, kỵ binh lạc đà xuất kích.

senses.description: The branch of chemistry concerned with fermentation, as in making wine, brewing, or distilling.

examples.en: He studied zymurgy to improve brewing.
examples.vi: Anh ấy nghiên cứu zymurgy để cải thiện quá trình ủ rượu.
